title: Advance Board notice of pharmacy closure
rule_summary: A resident pharmacy generally must give the Board written certified-mail notice at least 14 days before intended closure and provide the required closure and controlled-substance information.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply closure notice requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Advance Board notice of pharmacy closure

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing closure notice with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
